newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Erste to make fresh bid for CA.
newsitem.headline: Erste to make fresh bid for CA.

text.p: Austrian savings bank Die Erste (First Austrian) on Tuesday said it planned to form a consortium to bid for the government's stake in Creditanstalt-Bankverein.

"The board is empowered to set in motion measures to form and lead a strategically meaningful and financially strong bidding group within the framework of Creditanstalt's privatisation," Die Erste said in a statement.

Die Erste said its bid would aim to provide an "Austrian solution" to privatisation of the nation's second-biggest bank and would contribute to improving the efficiency of Austria's overcrowded banking sector.
It said shareholders and customers could also expect to benefit.
